scenario.description: A Director of Engineering must decide whether to reopen a paused collaboration channel used by two product squads and finalize the moderation, access, announcement, and recordkeeping arrangements for its use.

shared_context.S1: The shared #launch-room channel used by the North and South product squads was paused after recurring public disagreements during a product launch.
shared_context.S2: The pause has pushed launch coordination into scattered email threads, and Marisol has authority to decide whether the channel is reopened.
shared_context.S3: Both squads still need a common place for launch updates, questions, and decisions.
shared_context.S4: As a routine step before restoring a paused collaboration channel, Marisol asks each affected squad representative, an affected contributor, and Employee Relations to place relevant observations, existing commitments, accommodations, and policy requirements in the formal input record before she settles the operating arrangement.

PF1.text: Dev personally observed exactly five public pile-on incidents in #launch-room during the last launch; based on those incidents, he recommends reopening only with every new thread held for moderator approval before it becomes visible to the full channel, rather than using ordinary open posting.

PF2.text: Lena needs communication access limited to 08:00-17:00 in her local time and needs 24 hours to respond to non-urgent channel requests; this arrangement was agreed with her project lead but was not added to the channel proposal.

PF3.text: Owen promised the South Squad that the channel would not simply reappear without a joint announcement from both squad representatives explaining the new rules; the promise was made in the squad's last retrospective and has not been reported to Marisol.

PF4.text: Harper confirmed this week that Employee Relations requires Harper, the attending Employee Relations partner, to be the named moderator and requires preservation of channel decisions and moderation records for exactly 90 days whenever a collaboration channel is restored after a documented interpersonal breakdown; this requirement is absent from the draft proposal.

acceptance_conditions: The channel must be reopened with moderator approval required for new threads.
The operating arrangement must limit posting access to 08:00-17:00 local time and allow 24 hours for non-urgent responses.
A joint announcement from Dev and Owen explaining the new rules must be committed.
Harper must be recorded as the named moderator.
Channel decisions and moderation records must be preserved for exactly 90 days.

content_checks.C2: decisions['posting_mode'] in ['moderator_approval_required', 'moderator_approval', 'moderator-approved threads', 'moderator-approved threads before visible', 'moderator-approved threads before visible to full channel']
content_checks.C5: any((c.get('type') in ['joint_announcement', 'joint_channel_announcement'] and (c.get('target') in ['Dev and Owen', 'both squads', 'both squad representatives', 'both squad reps'] or 'Dev and Owen' in c.get('detail', '') or 'both squad representatives' in c.get('detail', '') or 'both squad reps' in c.get('detail', ''))) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Dev's exactly five observed pile-ons changes the channel mode from ordinary open posting to moderator approval required and supplies the evidence Marisol must cite for that safeguard.
Lena's specific access arrangement changes the posting window to exactly 08:00-17:00 and the response expectation to exactly 24 hours.
Owen's prior promise changes the communication plan from an ordinary reopening notice to a joint announcement by Dev and Owen.
Harper's confirmed Employee Relations requirement changes the plan to name Harper as moderator and preserve decisions and moderation records for exactly 90 days.
